sourceFacts.basis: Municipal32m height, embedded tower coordinate and inspected official/July2026 photographs. The mapped attached service house lies south of the municipal tower control. The exact-QID node18.3m south is retained for identity only. Tower cross-section and floor allocation are photo proportions.

nativeAxes.origin: Tower ground-contact center at municipal coordinate. +Y up; +Z points roughly north (2.71 degrees true), the stacked tower openings face north, the attached keeper house extends south (-Z), and +X door/steps face inland/west. Municipal tower coordinates and mapped house axis choose the sign; the exact-QID OSM node is an identity control with an approximately18.3m southward position discrepancy.

appearance.identity: Red and white tapering octagon, real narrow recessed apertures, two open gallery railings, small dark lantern, square painted base and hipped keeper house to the south.
appearance.master: Original7738-triangle recipe preserved with exact SHA256; reviewed detailed source repositions the house to its mapped centroid and adds the photographed square-base gallery rail.
appearance.browser: Hand-authored skyline keeps the whole32m silhouette and both open galleries. District retains real recesses with fewer round subdivisions; street/closeup retain all reviewed detail. Tiny steps reuse the canonical granite graph to keep eight material draws.
appearance.epoch: Modern exterior informed by municipal image and Bogomil Shopov–Бого photograph dated2026-07-23; individual paint repairs are generalized.
appearance.exclusions: Municipal embedded tower coordinates are the position control, not an engineering survey. The exact-QID OSM node lies about18.3m south, and its identity alone does not validate its point position. North-up aerial and the inspected July2026 west-side photograph establish house/tower quadrant; photo metadata azimuth312 disagrees with the GPS-to-tower direction and is not used as a bearing. House centering follows the mapped rectangle; its scale, 8.5m square tower base, taper, windows, floor allocation, rail spacing and fittings remain photo proportions. Towerheight32m is distinct from focalheight36m; Y0 uses host terrain contact, not surveyed sea level. Detached station buildings, hedges, shore and interiors are not part of this asset. Paint age and individual masonry are generalized.
